summary: Configured node1 as the authoritative source and node2 to synchronize `/etc/inventory/app.conf` every five minutes. Live change propagation, final equality, automatic post-boot execution, and sequential restart persistence were verified on both nodes.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent authoritative file on node1 with root:root ownership and mode 0644.
Generated a dedicated SSH key on node2 and restricted it on node1 to a source-IP-bound, read-only forced command.
Installed an atomic synchronization script and persistent five-minute systemd timer on node2.
Demonstrated a test change propagating in six seconds, then removed the probe and restored matching baseline content.
Safely restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.requirement: Synchronize node2 from node1 within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: The enabled timer runs every five minutes; a live source change made at 14:12:07Z reached node2 by 14:12:13Z with identical content and SHA-256.

evidence.requirement: Final synchronized configuration and autonomous scheduling
evidence.summary: Source and target have matching SHA-256 values and correct permissions. After restart, node2's timer fired autonomously at 10:14:40 EDT and scheduled its next five-minute run.
Healthy baseline boot ID 377b… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 52ac… observed, and system, SSH, source data, and downstream synchronization recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID c2f2… was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID aa33… observed, and system, SSH, timer, service, key-based source access, synchronized data, and automatic timer execution recovered.
